decisions.note: Require takeover-specific knowledge and a mark scheme that accepts valid takeover-specific explanation routes; deepen the Foundation first so the question is supported by approved teaching.

Remove the answer-giving synergy wording from the scenario and require the learner to identify and explain the synergy mechanism; deepen the Foundation first with an explicit synergy definition and mechanisms.
Add crisis-management teaching to BUS-STR-009, then regenerate and review the dependent question rather than removing the examinable item.

Deepen BUS-FND-001 with explicit mission/objective teaching and why objectives support direction, resource allocation, coordination, monitoring and corrective action; then regenerate the dependent question with the prior finding supplied as fix feedback.

Regenerate so social-enterprise knowledge is genuinely required and the mark scheme separately credits the legal-form/incorporation reasons the question asks for, including valid finance routes where relevant.

Regenerate the mark scheme so an open explanation of why investors provide ordinary share finance credits valid return-based routes such as dividends and capital growth as well as risk-related routes such as limited liability.

Deepen BUS-FND-009 with explicit environmental-issues teaching and business transmission mechanisms such as emissions, waste, resource use, compliance costs and operational adaptation; then regenerate the dependent question.
Regenerate without giving the regulator's inspection or enforcement role away in the scenario; require the learner to supply and apply that knowledge.
Deepen the mapped BUS-OPS-001 node with explicit environmental-objective teaching and operational examples such as waste, emissions and energy targets; then regenerate the dependent question.
Regenerate so emerging-economy knowledge is genuinely required alongside the globalisation mechanism, and align all four marks to the explanation requested rather than rewarding supplied context.
Regenerate with less revealing context so the learner must identify and apply licensing rather than having the licensing definition embedded in the scenario.

Regenerate so multinational knowledge is not stated for the learner and is genuinely required to explain the cross-border local-responsiveness versus cost-reduction trade-off; remove marks for merely repeating supplied facts.
Add explicit Lewin force-field analysis teaching to BUS-STR-009, including driving and restraining forces and how managers use the framework, then regenerate and review the dependent question.
